[name="???"](Unknown language) Dear Kal'tsit. If you have triggered this encrypted AI model, that means the hopes I left behind have been impeded—

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) Perhaps I myself have come to an untimely end.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Perhaps I myself have come to an untimely end.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) Dr. {@nickname}...

speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) You are surprised by my appearance, Kal'tsit. Have I failed?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) The future of Terra is yet unknown.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) The future of Terra is yet unknown.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) I never expected to see you again, Dr. {@nickname}—

content: (Unknown language) I never expected to see you again, Dr. {@nickname}—

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) This is simply an encrypted program encoded within my cognition model.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) This is simply an encrypted program encoded within my cognition model.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) It analyses data input and provides an appropriate response. In other words, it does not possess my emotions or memories.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) It analyses data input and provides an appropriate response. In other words, it does not possess my emotions or memories.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) I do not wish to disappoint you again, Kal'tsit.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) I do not wish to disappoint you again, Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) ...Why did you leave it behind?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) ...Why did you leave it behind?

speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Because of you.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) I know that you will only return here when all hope seems lost, in search of one last chance.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) I know that you will only return here when all hope seems lost, in search of one last chance.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) By then, however, I'm afraid that even I am unable to turn things around.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) By then, however, I'm afraid that even I am unable to turn things around.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) You cannot help me anymore?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) You cannot help me anymore?

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) My Sarcophagus will render what assistance is possible, to the extent that it is possible for me...
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) My Sarcophagus will render what assistance is possible, to the extent that it is possible for me...

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) Even when It descends upon us.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Even when It descends upon us.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) I didn't come to seek sanctuary, Dr. {@nickname}, but it's true that danger is very near.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) I didn't come to seek sanctuary, Dr. {@nickname}, but it's true that danger is very near.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) I need your help to take back PRTS.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) I need your help to take back PRTS.

speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) That will be difficult.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) The core databank of PRTS will deny access to the individual known as AMa-10. She has set this as an absolute prohibition.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) The core databank of PRTS will deny access to the individual known as AMa-10. She has set this as an absolute prohibition.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) Is there no way around it?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) Is there no way around it?

speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Perhaps there is one.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) If you are no longer AMa-10.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) If you are no longer AMa-10.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) AMa-10's gemini cycle system has granted you immortality. It appears that the two individuals in the cycle have diverged over the ages.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) AMa-10's gemini cycle system has granted you immortality. It appears that the two individuals in the cycle have diverged over the ages.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) Violence and wisdom, conflict and understanding... such evolution represents the most basic power of life.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Violence and wisdom, conflict and understanding... such evolution represents the most basic power of life.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) But these were duties forced upon you. They have become your shackles.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) But these were duties forced upon you. They have become your shackles.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) Now, I empower you to lay down your duty.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Now, I empower you to lay down your duty.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) This is the final gift that I can confer upon you by way of the Sarcophagus, but the ultimate decision is yours.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) This is the final gift that I can confer upon you by way of the Sarcophagus, but the ultimate decision is yours.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"](Unknown language) What reason is there to hesitate?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) What reason is there to hesitate?

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) I must remind you that this is extremely dangerous.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) I must remind you that this is extremely dangerous.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) When you become the interface to PRTS itself, the functions of the Sarcophagus will cause great harm to your physical form.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) When you become the interface to PRTS itself, the functions of the Sarcophagus will cause great harm to your physical form.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) The energy supply of the Sarcophagus is insufficient to fulfill your request and protect you at the same time.
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) The energy supply of the Sarcophagus is insufficient to fulfill your request and protect you at the same time.

raw: [name="Oracle"](Unknown language) Sanctuary will become torment, and you will forfeit any chance to extend your life. Are you sure you want to do this?
speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Sanctuary will become torment, and you will forfeit any chance to extend your life. Are you sure you want to do this?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: (Unknown language) I am sure.

speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) I respect your decision.

speaker: Oracle
content: (Unknown language) Goodbye.
